responsibility: Lowers HIR blocks and statements into THIR `Block` and `Stmt` nodes, assigning region scopes, preserving unsafe-block semantics, translating `let` statements with initializer and else blocks, and attaching user type ascriptions to let-patterns when type annotations were written.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `build/block.rs`, this `block.rs` operates on HIR and produces THIR `Block`/`Stmt` structures, setting up region scopes and statement forms for later stages instead of emitting MIR blocks, drops, storage, or tail-expression assignments.
